degenerateReason: aOptionalString is omitted when NULL, so != null is true for every set inner leaf (its negation false) and an error for a missing leaf or level: no row can be allowed. The empty oracle still fails any translation that returns a row; relation/or/negated-two-hops-not-null-or-negated-root-attribute carries the discriminating oracle.
trap: Rewriting the negation to a two-valued IS NULL returns b1, the rows with a parent but no inner, and the parentless rows, all of which CEL denies.
